I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread: the ticket number is **#88412**.

It's the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging, which froze while scanning the BOL barcode (bill of lading). Tobias Rendle raised it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025. That message clarified it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only passed on something they can already see. The ticket number is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.

I found the same thread in GBrain first, then read #central-team to confirm it. I couldn't find any ticket file for the account in the shared files, so this answer rests on that one message.
